title: vernonia ramospatana
intro: Vernonia ramospatana, commonly known as the "Bengal ironwort", is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The plant has been reported to exhibit several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of Vernonia ramospatana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
